failures.text: How does an idea get from a draft all the way to paper trading with real allocated capital?
failures.answer: Sir, a draft appears only when a fixed count how often it fires, and your yes registers it, so its test is written down before it runs. It is then tested on 2000-2023 data against the strict pass mark and, if it passes, runs as a 20-session paper trial on live sessions. Only if it beats random picks and the average stock on 10 separate sessions after costs, passes the check that no future data leaked in, and you say yes is it admitted, and only then may the allocated paper capital use it. Real money is a further step, the final real-money gate with your yes, and no rule has reached even the admitted step yet.
